title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Genesis 25: the death of Abraham, the sons of Ishmael, the birth of Esau and Jacob and the sold birthright.

questions.text: What was the name of the other wife Abraham took?
questions.explanation: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

questions.text: To whom did Abraham give all that he had?
questions.explanation: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

questions.text: How old was Abraham when he died?
questions.explanation: The years of Abraham's life were one hundred seventy-five years, and he died at a good old age.

questions.text: Who buried Abraham in the cave of Machpelah?
questions.explanation: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre.

questions.text: Who was the firstborn of Ishmael?
questions.explanation: The sons of Ishmael are listed in the order of their birth, and the firstborn was Nebaioth.

questions.text: How old was Isaac when he took Rebekah as his wife?
questions.explanation: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, to be his wife.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Rebekah about the two nations in her womb?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that one people would be stronger than the other and that the elder would serve the younger.

answers.text: "The two will live as one people."

questions.text: What was Jacob holding when he was born?
questions.explanation: His brother came out with his hand holding on to Esau's heel, and he was named Jacob.

questions.text: Why was Esau's name called Edom?
questions.explanation: Esau said, "Please feed me with some of that red stew," and therefore his name was called Edom.

answers.text: He asked to be fed with the red stew
He lived in the open field
He swore an oath to Jacob

questions.text: What did Jacob give Esau after Esau sold his birthright?
questions.explanation: After Esau swore and sold his birthright, Jacob gave him bread and lentil stew, and he ate and drank.
